title: Excellence Research Internship Program
field: Engineering, computer and basic sciences (EPFL research labs)
about: EPFL's Excellence Research Internship Program (ERIP) offers summer 2027 research internships in EPFL labs to top-ranked Bachelor's and Master's students from partner universities in North America and Singapore. Applications are open until 30 November 2026; shortlisting decisions follow in December.
requirements: Students at EPFL partner universities in North America and Singapore
Top 10% students at Bachelor's or Master's level
Complete applications only; late applications not considered

upskill.name: Prompt Engineering for Research & Knowledge Work
why: "summer 2027 research internships in EPFL labs" → "Design prompts for reviewing literature, identifying themes, extracting research information, and comparing findings across multiple sources."
"Engineering, computer and basic sciences (EPFL research labs)" → "Use iterative prompting workflows to move from broad exploration to focused analysis, synthesis, and research-oriented outputs."
